## Checklist

- [ ] I have read and followed the [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have linked an issue with maintainer signoff, or this PR only fixes typos or broken links in documentation or comments.

For code changes:

- [ ] There are no breaking changes, or maintainers have explicitly approved them.
- [ ] The code builds and runs without warnings.
- [ ] I have added appropriate test coverage for the changes.
- [ ] All test cases pass locally.

For Node.js code changes:

- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and `npm run format`.
